subject: literature
passage: Li Na wanted to finish her calligraphy practice quickly so she could go outside. Her grandfather, however, would not let her rush. He showed her the same stroke again and again, waited quietly while she tried it, and never raised his voice when ink blotted the page. Each time she failed, he simply laid a fresh sheet in front of her. He was the most ______ teacher Li Na had ever had.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The grandfather repeats the same stroke "again and again," waits "quietly," never raises his voice, and calmly gives Li Na a fresh sheet after each failure. Someone who stays calm through repeated mistakes is patient, so "patient" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. It is Li Na who wants to rush; her grandfather "would not let her" and takes his time.
explanation.B: Correct. Calmly repeating the lesson and offering a fresh sheet after every failure shows a patient teacher.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Nothing suggests the grandfather forgets anything; he repeats the stroke on purpose.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The grandfather "waited quietly" and "simply" handed over a new sheet; he is not described as talking much.
